title: Jekyll website builds
description: Auto-builds the website with Jekyll via CI2. Never builds from the asf-site branch. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#jekyll

whoami.description: Branch this configuration applies to. 'asf-site' is not allowed.

target.description: Branch to push the built site to. Defaults to the current branch.

notify.description: Recipients of build notifications. Defaults to the project's commits list.

outputdir.description: Directory the built site is written to.
